content.user_title: Add Capabilities to an Existing Convex App
content.value_statement: Adding a feature to a Convex app can mean finding the right setup instructions and component. This skill checks the Convex catalog first and has a fallback when no entry matches or the catalog is unreachable.
actual_capabilities: Identifies the requested capability from a natural-language request or an add command.
Matches the request against catalog titles, summaries, and triggers.
Loads the procedure and rules for a matching capability.
Uses the static hosting workflow for hosting when no catalog entry matches or the catalog is unreachable.
Searches for a Convex component for other requests and uses its README to guide setup.
Reports the hosting URL or component name after setup.
limitations: Works with an existing Convex app and does not create a new one.
Catalog lookup needs network access, and component search depends on the companion workflow being available.
A catalog match or search result does not guarantee that a procedure fits your app.
The skill contains instructions only. Installs and deployments require tools and permissions in the host environment.

use_cases.title: Publish an existing frontend
use_cases.description: Look up hosting for your Convex app and get the resulting URL after setup.

use_cases.title: Add a scheduled backend task
use_cases.description: Check the catalog for a cron procedure before changing the app.

use_cases.title: Find a search component
use_cases.description: Identify a catalog procedure or a component whose README supports the planned search integration.

prompt_templates.title: Add static hosting
prompt_templates.prompt: Add static hosting to this existing Convex app. Ask before publishing and report the URL after deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Look up scheduled jobs
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the Convex procedure for adding a daily cleanup job. Explain what needs to change before editing any files.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a search integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the best match for search in this Convex app. Use component search if the catalog has no match. Explain the selection before installing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Review a candidate before adding a dependency.

prompt_templates.title: Plan billing for a test deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Convex catalog to plan billing for this app. List the prerequisites and proposed changes for a test deployment. Do not install or deploy until I approve.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Review a billing integration before it affects an environment.

output_examples.input: Add hosting to this existing Convex app.
output_examples.output: The catalog had no hosting match, so I used the static hosting workflow. The deployment succeeded, and the confirmation includes the live URL.

output_examples.input: Find a way to add search without installing anything yet.
output_examples.output: The catalog had no match. Component search returned a candidate, and its README lists the setup steps. No dependencies were installed.

output_examples.input: Check how to add a scheduled task before editing the app.
output_examples.output: The catalog matched the request to a cron procedure. The next step is to review where the job should be registered. No files were changed.

best_practices: Name the capability and specify which Convex app and deployment it should affect.
Review the catalog procedure or component README before approving dependencies or project changes.
Keep approval checks enabled and authorize only the network access or operations you need.
anti_patterns: Use this skill to create a new Convex app from scratch.
Install the top search result without checking that it fits your app.
Enable auto-approve to work around a blocked command.

faq.question: Does this skill create a Convex app?
faq.answer: No. It adds a capability to an existing Convex app.

faq.question: Does the skill need network access?
faq.answer: Yes, to fetch the live catalog and any matching procedure. The fallback runs if the catalog is unavailable.

faq.question: What happens if no catalog entry matches?
faq.answer: Hosting uses the static hosting workflow. Other requests use the component search workflow.

faq.question: What does the skill report after setup?
faq.answer: It reports the hosting URL for hosting or the component name for a component install.

faq.question: Can I review the setup before installation or deployment?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask for the proposed changes first and require approval before installing, editing, or publishing.

faq.question: What should I do if the host blocks a command?
faq.answer: Keep the approval controls enabled. Review the blocked operation and authorize it individually if appropriate.
